patterns.note: Asymmetrical grid layout for image galleries, often paired with a fixed-width left sidebar for textual content on interior pages, creating a balanced yet dynamic composition.
Minimalist monochrome base (white background, black text) that allows the diverse and often vibrant imagery to be the primary focal point and source of color.
Image cards reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animation as they enter the viewport during scroll, creating a smooth, engaging content discovery experience.
A single, clean sans-serif typeface is used consistently across all text elements, with hierarchy established through subtle variations in weight and size rather than distinct font families.

technique_notes: Implement a smooth scrolling experience using a library like locomotive-scroll, where individual grid items (image cards) are animated to fade in and slide up slightly as they become visible within the viewport.

Design a flexible grid system for image galleries that can accommodate varying aspect ratios and sizes, often integrating a dedicated, fixed-width sidebar for project details or navigation on interior pages.
Apply a consistent, generous border-radius to all image containers to create a soft, modern aesthetic that unifies the visual presentation of diverse photographic content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Small, clean sans-serif for body text and navigation, with headings and labels using slightly larger and bolder weights of the same family for subtle hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded, consistently applied to all image cards and content blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous padding around content sections and consistent, moderate gutters within image grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of prominent, consistent rounded corners on all image cards, combined with a minimalist layout and subtle scroll-triggered reveals, transforms a standard portfolio grid into a sophisticated, gallery-like experience that feels both modern and luxurious.
